tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. A grey pulled slightly toward forest, never pure white or cream.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The one raised fill: the phone screen, app icon tiles, inline code. Set apart from paper by a line border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and decorative outlines. Too faint for control borders; use line-strong there.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders on inputs and controls, the phone bezel outline, inactive page dots. At least 3:1 on paper and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper, surface and forest-tint.

tokens.name: graphite-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, mono labels, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: The brand color. Links, primary actions, the active page dot, focus rings. As text on paper, surface and forest-tint.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a forest fill.

tokens.name: forest-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet tinted fields: selected rows, the onboarding backdrop, a highlighted app tile.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: The accent. Used once per screen at most: the wiggle-invite badge, a 'new' marker, a single emphasized word. As text only on paper; on surface use it for marks, not words.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: I design and build things for screens.
styles.usage: The hero intro line only. Drop to 40px below 768px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles and the in-phone app header.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings and onboarding slide titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I grew up between two cities and learned to read both.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Tap an app to open it.
styles.usage: Text inside the phone, captions under images.

styles.name: icon-label
styles.usage: The label under each app icon on the home grid.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase metadata: years, places, roles, file-style tags. Never for sentences.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Inline code, the phone status bar clock, numeric values that line up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, dot to dot.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label over value, bezel thickness.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; the mobile side gutter; app grid gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding inside the phone screen; app grid gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections within a page; desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between major page sections; top padding above the hero intro.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon tiles at 56px. Scale with the tile: 25% of its side.

tokens.name: radius-screen
tokens.usage: The phone screen. Always radius-device minus the bezel (space-2).

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: The phone body. Not used on anything else.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and divider.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, drawn in forest with a 2px offset.
